products.title: HARMONY GIFT SET - I
products.body_html:
Indulge in the elegance of scent with the Jasmine & Honey Gift Collection — a luxurious trio crafted for those who appreciate the poetry of fine perfumery.

This curated set brings together two expressions of the beloved Jasmine & Honey blend — in both Eau de Parfum and Concentrated Perfume Oil — designed to be worn alone or layered for enhanced depth and longevity. Paired with the refreshing warmth of Cardamom & Apple Eau de Parfum, this collection invites you to create your own signature harmony of floral sweetness, soft gourmand nuance, and aromatic spice.

Set Includes:

Jasmine & Honey – Eau De Parfum – 100ml

Jasmine & Honey – Concentrated Perfume Oil – 12ml

Cardamom & Apple – Eau De Parfum – 100ml

products.title: TOBACCO 01 - GIFT SET
products.body_html:
Elevate your fragrance experience with the Tobacco 01 Gift Collection — a luxurious trio designed for layering and perfect for gifting.

This exclusive set combines the Tobacco 01 Extrait De Parfum, the concentrated Perfume Oil, and the complementary Muattar, allowing you to create a personalized signature scent with depth, warmth, and sophistication. Sweet top notes of plum, apple, and honey mingle with spicy pink pepper and labdanum, leading to a heart of amber, ylang-ylang, and patchouli, and resting on a base of musk, cashmere, honey, vanilla, sandalwood, and tobacco.

Set Includes:

Tobacco 01 – Extrait De Parfum – 50ml

Tobacco 01 – Concentrated Perfume Oil – 12ml

Tobacco 01 – Muattar – 50g

products.title: SHAGHAF OUD AHMAR - GIFT SET
products.body_html:
Indulge in the opulence of Shaghaf Oud Ahmar with this exquisite Gift Collection — a trio crafted for those who desire warmth, richness, and a truly memorable scent experience.

Inspired by the fragrance’s signature blend of sparkling freshness, luscious fruits, and luxurious amber woods, this set brings together three complementary forms of Shaghaf Oud Ahmar, allowing you to enhance, amplify, and layer your scent ritual. 

Set Includes:

Shaghaf Oud Ahmar – Eau De Parfum – 75ml

Shaghaf Oud Ahmar – Concentrated Perfume Oil – 12ml

Shaghaf Oud Ahmar – Muattar – 50g
